theory.title: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones
theory.explanation: Usa if + pasado simple y would + verbo base para imaginar una situación presente o futura irreal o poco probable: If I had more savings, I would buy a smaller car (si tuviera más ahorros, compraría un coche más pequeño). En hipótesis formales, were puede utilizarse con todos los sujetos.
theory.tip: If + pasado simple, would + infinitivo para imaginar situaciones poco probables.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 1
patterns.pattern: If I had a bigger budget, I would buy a better laptop.
examples:
If I had a bigger budget, I would buy a better laptop.
→ Si tuviera un presupuesto mayor, compraría un portátil mejor.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 2
patterns.pattern: If prices were lower, more people would shop locally.
examples:
If prices were lower, more people would shop locally.
→ Si los precios fueran más bajos, más gente compraría en tiendas locales.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 3
patterns.pattern: We would save money if we cooked at home.
examples:
We would save money if we cooked at home.
→ Ahorraríamos dinero si cocináramos en casa.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 4
patterns.pattern: If I were the manager, I would improve the refund policy.
examples:
If I were the manager, I would improve the refund policy.
→ Si yo fuera el gerente, mejoraría la política de reembolsos.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 5
patterns.pattern: She would change jobs if she earned more.
examples:
She would change jobs if she earned more.
→ Ella cambiaría de trabajo si ganara más.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 6
patterns.pattern: If the delivery were free, I would order today.
examples:
If the delivery were free, I would order today.
→ Si el envío fuera gratis, haría el pedido hoy.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 7
patterns.pattern: They would spend less if they planned their budget.
examples:
They would spend less if they planned their budget.
→ Gastarían menos si planificaran su presupuesto.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 8
patterns.pattern: If I had more time, I would compare the prices.
examples:
If I had more time, I would compare the prices.
→ Si tuviera más tiempo, compararía los precios.

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 9
patterns.pattern: What would you buy if you won a voucher?
examples:
What would you buy if you won a voucher?
→ ¿Qué comprarías si ganaras un vale?

patterns.label: Segundo condicional para hablar de dinero y decisiones · 10
patterns.pattern: If the shop accepted cash, I would pay in person.
examples:
If the shop accepted cash, I would pay in person.
→ Si la tienda aceptara efectivo, pagaría en persona.

content.passage: If Marta had a larger monthly budget, she would buy a more energy-efficient washing machine. She would also choose local shops if prices were more competitive. Her brother says he would spend less if he planned his purchases in advance. If they were more careful with small expenses, they would save enough for a holiday. They both agree that comparing prices is a useful habit.

items.prompt: What would you buy if you had an extra hundred pounds?
items.modelAnswer: When I buy something, I usually compare prices and read the conditions carefully. If there is a problem, I contact customer service and explain what has happened. I think a good company should listen to customers and offer a fair solution. I keep receipts and confirmation emails in case I need them later. Planning purchases helps me manage my budget and avoid unnecessary expenses.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
